entry.name: fluid.pitch~
entry.description: Three popular monophonic pitch descriptors, all of which compute frequency and confidence.

attributes.name: algorithm
attributes.digest: Algorithm
attributes.description: The algorithm to estimate the pitch. (The default is 2.) The options are:

choices.label: Cepstrum: Returns a pitch estimate as the location of the highest peak (not including DC) in the Cepstrum of the signal.

Harmonic Product Spectrum: Implements the Harmonic Product Spectrum algorithm for pitch detection . See e.g. A. Lerch, "An Introduction to Audio Content Analysis: Applications in Signal Processing and Music Informatics." John Wiley & Sons, 2012.https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/book/10.1002/9781118393550

YinFFT: Implements the frequency domain version of the YIN algorithm, as described in P. M. Brossier, "Automatic Annotation of Musical Audio for Interactive Applications.” QMUL, London, UK, 2007. See also
